details.text: All five transformer pads within 4 feet of vehicle circulation routes require 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollard protection; no bollard specifications shown in construction details (Sheets 22-27) or locations indicated on electrical plan (Sheet 21); spacing must allow equipment door opening per AE Design details.

runComments.comment: Clearances from transformer pads to parking areas are not dimensioned, and bollard protection details are not shown on electrical plan.

All transformer pads are positioned within 4 feet of vehicle circulation routes and therefore require protective bollards. No bollards are shown on the electrical plan or detailed in construction details. Applicant must add 4-inch diameter galvanized rigid metal bollard details to the construction detail sheets and indicate bollard locations on Sheet 21, spaced to allow equipment door opening per AE Design equipment pad specifications.

Site plan (Sheet 9) shows parking layout and transformer pad locations, but no clearance dimensions are provided showing whether transformer pads are within 4 feet of parking areas. If within this distance, 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollards with proper spacing per AE Design details are not shown. Bollard specifications cannot be verified.
